final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type IN ('Commercial unit', 'Office building')
  AND surface_area >= 99
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 5.0
  AND energy_score_plant >= 3
  AND green >= 31.88
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC
